hbm_per_token.scope: KV/index HBM bytes of ONE decode token at position 1,048,575 (TP4: 4 ranks x 4 HBM3E stacks); Engram tables are in mask ROM on the DS-ROM (0 HBM bytes); weights in ROM (0 HBM bytes)

index_scan.ratio1_reindex_L24_L28_L32_L36_as_built: same read as L20 (the native index unit scores all keys, then masks)

ckv_selected_gather.note: 512 scattered rows: latency bound, not bandwidth bound

window_rows.note: 128-row window load, latency bound (first beat at ~110 cycles)

headline.basis: as_built.lat259: every context-dependent term measured in full-shape RTL at position 1,048,575 (index read on timed HBM, select on the golden 1M scores, CKV gather + q.k on the golden 1M selections, CKV HBM latency 259 cycles, conservative over the reader's measured 87-88 ns mean)
headline.interim: L20 (global-KV scan layer) is this tool's component measurement; Codex's S81 minimum run owns L20 at 1M and replaces it when it lands
still_modelled: context-independent nodes of every layer (weights in ROM: projections, MoE, norms, softmax/p.v at T = 640, hc/Sinkhorn) from the S81 unified graph
stage hop 0.482 us (RTL endpoint + technology channel delay, no PHY)
head 13.63 us in the AR path (wavefront II uses the measured reduced-shape head 12.37 us)
L1+L2 NV5 draft (56.07 us): SS pre-layout screen fails, not closed

idxkey_layout.basis: candidate_gather variant: re-index index read = the ROW-LAYOUT gather (worst rank of the real 1M lists, both placements) and the select on its RTL beat stream; previous = the super-block gather
